SELECT br.id, br.user_id as userId, br.device_id as deviceId, br.device_instance_id as deviceInstanceId, br.quantity, br.purpose, br.expected_return_date as expectedReturnDate, br.actual_return_date as actualReturnDate, br.status, br.approve_user_id as approveUserId, br.approve_time as approveTime, br.approve_remark as approveRemark, br.return_remark as returnRemark, br.created_at as createdAt, br.updated_at as updatedAt, u.username, u.real_name as realName, d.name as deviceName, d.model as deviceModel, di.instance_name as deviceInstanceName FROM borrow_records br LEFT JOIN users u ON br.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN devices d ON br.device_id = d.id LEFT JOIN device_instances di ON br.device_instance_id = di.id
AND br.status = 'PENDING'
AND d.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{deviceName}, '%')
AND u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%')
ORDER BY br.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_records br LEFT JOIN users u ON br.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN devices d ON br.device_id = d.id
AND br.status = 'PENDING'
AND d.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{deviceName}, '%')
AND u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_records br LEFT JOIN users u ON br.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN devices d ON br.device_id = d.id
AND br.status = #{status}
AND d.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{deviceName}, '%')
AND u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%')
